# Hermes Agent v0.22.5 (2026.9.24), 2026-11-03 (#439): a Hermes home whose skills/ holds Harness's links
# into an engine's skill/ — harness/ a dir with a SKILL.md symlink, harness-start and handoff dir symlinks.
# $H is a throwaway HERMES_HOME; <engine> stands for the engine checkout the links name.
# The security warnings are the throwaway home's: it is not ~/.hermes, which the check names literally.
$ readlink $H/skills/{harness-start,handoff,harness/SKILL.md}
harness-start -> <engine>/skill/harness-start
handoff -> <engine>/skill/handoff
harness/SKILL.md -> <engine>/skill/SKILL.md
$ HERMES_HOME=$H hermes skills list
